title: Before the first song
blurb: Help music fans save a festival set for offline listening.

screens.heading: Help people finish a task.
screens.body: UX means user experience. Designers study what people need, then test ways to help.

beats.question: Save sits below a long description. Which change should you test first?

choices.label: Move Save beside the set title.
choices.why: One clear change tests whether people can find it.

choices.label: Change every label and color.
choices.why: Many changes make the result harder to explain.

choices.label: Remove offline saving.
choices.why: That removes the feature fans need.

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.question: Check the keyboard path.

items.question: What shows which control is selected?

options.label: A color change only on mouse hover.
options.why: Mouse hover does not show keyboard focus.

items.question: How does Noah move to the next control?

options.label: Move the pointer.
options.why: Pointer movement does not test keyboard access.

items.question: What should happen when Save has focus?

options.label: Enter activates Save.
options.why: A keyboard user needs to activate the focused control.

options.label: Only a mouse click can activate it.
options.why: The task must work without a mouse.

beats.whenPass: The focus is visible, moves by keyboard, and activates the control.
beats.whenFail: Check the visible focus, Tab movement, and keyboard activation.

beats.title: The check is complete.
